Package io.webagent4j.crawler

Class DefaultUrlNormalizer

java.lang.Object
io.webagent4j.crawler.DefaultUrlNormalizer
All Implemented Interfaces:
IUrlNormalizer
public final class DefaultUrlNormalizer extends Object implements IUrlNormalizer
Deterministic IUrlNormalizer: lowercases scheme and host, drops the fragment, drops a default port (:80 for http, :443 for https), resolves ./ .. path segments (URI.normalize()), maps an empty path to "/", and applies a fixed QueryParameterPolicy - never reordering surviving query parameters or re-encoding anything, so already-valid percent-encoding is never corrupted.

A trailing slash on a non-empty path is left exactly as given: /products and /products/ are not collapsed into each other, since many servers treat them as different resources - only the empty path is normalized, to /, per RFC 3986's own equivalence rule.

normalize(normalize(uri)) always equals normalize(uri): every step is either already-idempotent (URI.normalize()) or applies the exact same deterministic rule to already-canonical input.
